ios.desc:
Wall G is a multiplayer, turn-based strategy game where every move shapes the board. Play casually online or offline, train against AI, or challenge yourself to find the most efficient path to victory.

Players move pieces and place walls to enclose territory, gradually defining the space they control. The objective isn’t to block your opponent — it’s to claim more territory by thinking ahead and positioning carefully.

Simple to learn but difficult to master, Wall G rewards planning, spatial awareness, and long-term strategy. Each match unfolds differently, with walls creating unique paths, regions, and tactical decisions.

Designed for calm, focused play, Wall G offers a minimalist experience that emphasizes depth over speed and strategy over reflexes.

quotes.text:
After watching the Netflix Reality: Devil's Plan S2, building a mobile version of the strategy game 'Wall Go' has been on my todo list.

Finally, this winter, I had some time and i decided to build it solo and managed to finish it in a week (though vacation break + going back and forth with apple took 3 weeks more).

Now, it is launched and I want to promote this game cause it is a super fun strategy game. Can be played PvP or Offline (2-4 players).

App Store Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wallg/id6757427666

I am a senior CS student and super new in game dev (been doing more SWE and AI). So I would love some feedbacks on the game and app experience + play this game with strangers :)

Also first post in hackernews, hopefully more to come as i get more time to build stuff after graduating
